notes.title: Changelog – Version 1.1.8
notes.notes:
This update brings fresh atmosphere and a brand-new way to fight back!

🌦️ Enhanced Atmosphere
[list]
[*] Added weather effects (rain and snow) to several levels to make the world feel more alive.
[/list]

⚡ New Melee Attack
[list]
[*] A brand-new close-combat option is now available!
[*] Press E or F (or use the triggers on a gamepad) to strike enemies with a melee bash.
[*] A lightning-shaped icon at the bottom-left of the screen shows the attack’s cooldown.
[/list]

🔧 Performance & Maintenance
[list]
[*] General performance optimizations.
[*] Various technical fixes for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Time to face the storm — and bash your enemies away! 💥

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Changelog
notes.notes:
Experience smoother gameplay and improved performance in Sea of Dreams Survivors! This update brings major optimizations, bug fixes, and achievement improvements to make your journey even more enjoyable.

[h1]Performance & Technology[/h1]
[list]
[*] CPU Optimizations: Reduced processing load for smoother gameplay.
[*] Renderer Improvements: Optimized rendering pipeline for better frame rates.
[*] Engine Upgrade: Migrated from Monogame to KNI.
[*] Framework Update: Bumped to .NET 9 for improved stability and compatibility.
[/list]

[h1]Achievements & Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed "Why I doing this" achievement (too difficult).
[*] Fixed enemy kill achievements that were not triggering correctly.
[/list]

[h1]Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*] Updated Credits.
[*] Multiple behind-the-scenes improvements and bug fixes for enhanced stability.
[/list]

Enjoy a faster, smoother, and more polished Sea of Dreams Survivors!

notes.title: 🛠️ Patch Notes – July 31, 2025
notes.notes:
Today’s update focuses on improving the user interface and enhancing aiming clarity across all setups:

[b]🔧 UI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The interface now scales properly based on your screen resolution.
[*] All players will now experience a consistent UI size, from sub-HD to 8K resolutions.
[*] UI elements are larger and more readable, improving overall visibility and comfort.
[/list]

[b]🎯 New Crosshair Feature[/b]
[list]
[*] A new crosshair replaces the system cursor during gameplay to help you aim more accurately.
[*] The crosshair is also available when using a gamepad.
[*] Want the old style? You can disable the crosshair via the "More Settings" menu.
[/list]

[b]🖱️ Custom Interface Cursor[/b]
[list]
[*] A custom cursor has been added to the game's interface for a more cohesive look and feel.
[/list]

notes.title: 📦 Patch Notes - July 19, 2025
notes.notes:
Today's update brings several improvements to performance, UI, and gameplay feedback based on your feedback. Here's what's new:

🩸 Performance
[list]
[*]Fixed a major performance issue related to excessive blood effects on the ground.
[/list]

🖥️ UI & Menus
[list]
[*]The Main Menu and Level Selection screens have been reworked slightly.
[*]"Career" and "Upgrades" are now accessible directly from the Main Menu for easier access.
[*]Improved keyboard and gamepad support in the level selection screen.
[/list]

🕹️ Gameplay Feedback & Visuals
[list]
[*]The "Drop" arrow indicator is now more visible and tinted yellow for better clarity during gameplay.
[*]The damage feedback color when getting hit (with or without a shield) is now yellow—making hits more noticeable.
[*]The shield indicator has been updated from brown to blue for greater visibility. Its size and position have also been slightly adjusted for better in-game clarity.
[/list]

Thanks again for all your feedback and reports—keep them coming!

notes.title: 🛠️ Post-Launch Patch – Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Thank you for all the feedback following the launch of Sea of Dreams Survivors! We've just released a small patch to address a few early issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed some texture issues in various levels 
[*] Fixed incorrect shield (hurt) color for certain players
[*] Fixed the Exit button not functioning properly
[/list]

notes.title: Sea of Dreams Survivors Demo 2 (Update)
notes.notes:
[b]UI & Controls[/b]
[list]
[*] Full Navigation Overhaul: Gamepad and keyboard navigation have been completely reworked for a smoother and more intuitive experience throughout the UI.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Feedback[/b]
[list]
[*] Damage Feedback Added: New visual cues now appear when your character takes damage, helping you react more quickly in the heat of battle.
[*] Improved Hit Sound: The sound played when taking damage has been updated for better clarity and impact.
[*] Player Visibility Enhancements: Never lose track of your survivor again—your character now remains visible through explosions via a new transparency overlay.
[/list]

[b]Visual Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Armored Engineer Redesign: This enemy now features an updated texture, giving it a more distinctive and menacing look.
[/list]

[b]Performance & Polish[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor enhancements and optimizations have been implemented to improve overall stability and performance.
[/list]
